wikidot5e:wondrous-items:dancing-sword.effectSummary: As a bonus action, toss the sword and speak its command word. It hovers, flies up to 30 feet, and attacks one creature within 5 feet using your attack roll and ability modifier for damage. While it hovers, a bonus action can move it up to 30 feet to a point within 30 feet of you and make another attack. After its fourth hovering attack, it flies up to 30 feet toward your hand; if you have no free hand it falls at your feet, and if blocked it moves as close as possible before falling. It also stops hovering if you grasp it or move more than 30 feet from it.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:danoths-visor.effectSummary: Dormant: while worn, see normally through magical and nonmagical darkness to 60 feet and gain advantage on sight-based Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Perception). Awakened: also see invisible creatures and objects within 60 feet and into the Ethereal Plane; once per dawn, as a bonus action, gain 1 minute of 60-foot vision through solid matter, penetrating up to 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or 3 feet of wood or dirt but not lead; and as a bonus action toggle spyglass mode, magnifying viewed creatures and objects to twice apparent size. Exalted: automatically detect visible illusions and automatically succeed on saves against them, see a bright aura around creatures not in their true form, and once per dawn cast antimagic field as an action.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:daouds-wondrous.effectSummary: Artifact with 2 random minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, and 1 minor detrimental property. It burns powdered gemstones, holds up to 10,000 gp of fuel, is found with 9,000 gp, and automatically attempts to consume 100 gp each year to keep burning another year; add fuel during a short or long rest, and added fuel cannot be removed. If the flame goes out for lack of fuel, its attuned creature immediately dies. It normally sheds bright light 60 feet and dim another 60, revealing invisible creatures and objects in the bright light; the attuned bearer may use a bonus action to dim it to 5 feet of dim light or restore normal brightness. During a short or long rest, change any of its four gem lenses. As an action while holding it, burn fuel to cast through current lenses with save DC 20, with target or origin in its bright light: amethyst reverse gravity 3,000 gp; diamond disintegrate 2,000 gp; emerald haste 500 gp; jacinth flame strike 1,000 gp; ruby hold monster 1,000 gp; sapphire fear 500 gp; topaz slow 500 gp; any four colors prismatic wall 5,000 gp. If insufficient fuel remains, all remaining fuel is spent and the flame goes out. To destroy it, the attuned creature must voluntarily give up every material possession except the lantern and common clothes, then intentionally snuff its flame; the lantern corrodes and its lenses and fuel become worthless while the attuned creature survives.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:dark-shard-amul.effectSummary: While worn, use the amulet as a focus for warlock spells. Once per long rest, attempt to cast a warlock-list cantrip you do not know by making DC 10 Intelligence (Arcana); on success the cantrip is cast, on failure the spell and its action fail, and either result expends the use.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:dawnbringer.effectSummary: A sentient neutral-good gilded longsword hilt for a non-evil attuned creature. As a bonus action, manifest or dismiss its radiant blade; it has all properties of a sun blade. Once per dawn while holding it, use an action to touch a creature with the blade and cast lesser restoration. Sentience: Intelligence 12, Wisdom 15, Charisma 14; hearing and darkvision 120 feet; telepathic with its wielder; speaks, reads, and understands Common and knows every language its attuned wielder knows. It seeks to bring light into darkness and oppose creatures of darkness, is compassionate to those in need, fears darkness and abandonment, prefers to keep its blade lit in dark places, and strongly resists prolonged separation from its wielder.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:decanter-of-end.effectSummary: As an action, remove the stopper and speak a command word to pour fresh or salt water until the start of your next turn. Stream produces 1 gallon; Fountain produces 5 gallons; Geyser produces 30 gallons in a 30-foot-long, 1-foot-wide jet. While holding the decanter during Geyser, use a bonus action to aim at a visible creature within 30 feet; DC 13 Strength or it takes 1d4 bludgeoning and falls prone. Instead target one unattended object weighing no more than 200 pounds to knock it over or push it up to 15 feet away.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:deck-of-dimensi.effectSummary: The deck has 6 charges and regains 1d6 daily at dawn. Marked Card: bonus action, spend 1 charge to place a card in an unoccupied space within 5 feet; once during the next 24 hours, use an action and speak its name to teleport with worn/carried gear to the closest open space at that card. After teleporting or after 8 hours, it returns to the deck and loses its mark. Riffling Portal: action, spend 3 charges to cast arcane gate; the deck becomes the spell's card-formed portal rings and returns when the spell ends. Shuffling Stride: bonus action, spend 1 charge to throw a card to an unoccupied space within 60 feet and teleport yourself and worn/carried gear there; the card then vanishes back into the deck.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:deck-of-illusio.effectSummary: A full deck has 34 cards; found decks usually lack 1d20-1. Its magic works only on random draws. As an action, draw and throw a card to a point within 30 feet, creating a harmless but lifelike creature illusion that lasts until dispelled or its card moves. While within 120 feet and able to see it, use an action to move the illusion anywhere within 30 feet of its card. Physical interaction reveals it; a creature can use an action and DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) to recognize it, after which it appears translucent. Used cards lose their image and cannot be reused. Card results: hearts—Ace red dragon; King knight + four guards; Queen succubus/incubus; Jack druid; 10 cloud giant; 9 ettin; 8 bugbear; 2 goblin. Diamonds—Ace beholder; King archmage + mage apprentice; Queen night hag; Jack assassin; 10 fire giant; 9 oni/ogre mage; 8 gnoll; 2 kobold. Spades—Ace lich; King priest + two acolytes; Queen medusa; Jack veteran; 10 frost giant; 9 troll; 8 hobgoblin; 2 goblin. Clubs—Ace iron golem; King bandit captain + three bandits; Queen erinyes; Jack berserker; 10 hill giant; 9 ogre; 8 orc; 2 kobold. Either Joker creates an illusion of the deck's owner.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:deck-of-many-mo.effectSummary: A 44-card companion deck often combined with the Deck of Many Things. Before drawing, declare how many cards you will draw. Draw each within 1 hour of the previous; drawing beyond the declared number has no effect unless a card authorizes extra draws, and failing to complete the declared draws makes the remaining cards fly out and resolve simultaneously. A drawn card takes effect immediately and normally fades then returns to the deck; Fool and Jester are exceptions. Random d100 mapping is 01 Aberration, 02 Balance, 03 Beast, 04 Book, 05 Bridge, 06 Campfire, 07 Cavern, 08 Celestial, 09 Comet, 10 Construct, 11 Corpse, 12 Crossroads, 13 Donjon, 14 Door, 15 Dragon, 16 Elemental, 17 Euryale, 18 Expert, 19 Fates, 20 Fey, 21 Fiend, 22 Flames, 23 Fool, 24 Gem, 25 Giant, 26 Humanoid, 27 Jester, 28 Key, 29 Knight, 30 Lance, 31 Mage, 32 Map, 33 Maze, 34 Mine, 35 Monstrosity, 36 Moon, 37 Ooze, 38 Path, 39 Pit, 40 Plant, 41 Priest, 42 Prisoner, 43 Puzzle, 44 Ring, 45 Rogue, 46 Ruin, 47 Sage, 48 Shield, 49 Ship, 50 Skull, 51 Staff, 52 Stairway, 53 Star, 54 Statue, 55 Sun, 56 Talons, 57 Tavern, 58 Temple, 59 Throne, 60 Tomb, 61 Tower, 62 Tree, 63 Undead, 64 Void, 65 Warrior, 66 Well, 67–00 reroll. Effects: Aberration grants 90-foot telepathy. Balance reverses law/chaos and good/evil alignment axes, with true neutral/unaligned unaffected. Beast transforms you for 2d12 days into a random CR 5-or-lower beast; statistics are replaced, nonmagical gear melds, magic items drop, nothing except wish can alter the form early, and reverting restores your prior state. Book grants 1d6+2 languages. Bridge grants 1d3 castings of time stop using your choice of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Campfire grants a long rest immediately. Cavern grants a climbing speed equal to walking speed and hands-free movement on vertical surfaces and ceilings. Celestial grants luminous wings and 30-foot flying speed. Comet grants enough XP for one level if you single-handedly defeat the next hostile monster or group, otherwise no effect. Construct creates a loyal homunculus in an open space within 5 feet. Corpse drops you to 0 HP and unconscious; you make death saves, cannot regain HP magically until stabilized, and if three failures kill you only wish can resurrect you. Crossroads changes age by 1d10 years—older on an even d20, younger on odd to minimum age 1—reversible only by wish, divine intervention, or similar magic. Donjon imprisons you in suspended animation in an extradimensional sphere, leaves gear behind, blocks divination, can be located by wish, and ends further draws. Door grants 1d4 component-free gate castings using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Dragon creates a DM-chosen dragon wyrmling that treats you as its parent and is loyal to you and allies. Elemental grants permanent immunity to one chosen acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage type. Euryale curses you with -2 to all saves until ended by a god or Fates. Expert raises Dexterity by 2 to maximum 22. Fates lets you erase one event at any time before death as though it never happened. Fey immediately pulls you through a fey crossing to a DM-chosen Feywild location and ends further draws; the crossing remains open 1 minute. Fiend creates a powerful fiend that offers a DM-determined bargain, keeps its agreement but may exploit wording, and returns home if attacked or negotiations fail. Flames makes a powerful devil your enemy until one of you dies. Fool loses 10,000 XP without losing a level below its threshold, discards itself, and forces another draw that counts as the same declared draw. Gem creates either 25 jewelry pieces worth 2,000 gp each or 50 gems worth 1,000 gp each. Giant increases height by 2d10 inches and raises both current and maximum HP by 20. Humanoid lets you stop drawing immediately regardless of declared number. Jester grants 10,000 XP or two extra draws. Key creates a DM-chosen rare-or-rarer magic weapon with which you are proficient. Knight creates a loyal same-race 4th-level fighter under your control until death. Lance raises all ability scores by 1 to maximum 20. Mage raises Intelligence by 2 to maximum 22. Map, once within 1 year, lets you mentally name or describe a familiar object or individual and learn its exact location and distance across planes; for creatures also learn alive/dead and conditions, for objects learn broken status, and for charged magic items learn remaining charges. Maze gives 1d3 exhaustion levels. Mine creates 2d6 gems worth 5,000 gp each plus 1d10 precious-ore chunks worth 2,500 gp each. Monstrosity creates a hostile DM-chosen Large-or-larger CR 10-or-lower monstrosity within 15 feet that attacks immediately and remains until killed or you reach 0 HP; no effect if space is insufficient. Moon grants 1d3 wish castings. Ooze creates a hostile gelatinous cube in your space that immediately engulfs you and remains until destroyed; no effect if space is insufficient. Path raises walking speed by 10 feet. Pit opens beneath you and drops you 3d6×10 feet, causing normal falling damage and prone. Plant grants speak with plants once per long rest without a slot and also with 3rd-level-or-higher slots, using your choice of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Priest raises Wisdom by 2 to maximum 22. Prisoner restrains you in indestructible force chains, suppresses your magic-item properties and spellcasting, ends further draws, and can be removed only by disintegrate or another creature succeeding on DC 30 Dexterity with thieves' tools. Puzzle permanently lowers Intelligence by 1d4+1 to minimum 1 and grants one extra draw. Ring creates a DM-chosen rare-or-rarer magic ring on your finger and automatically attunes it if you have a free attunement slot. Rogue makes a DM-chosen NPC irreversibly hostile except by wish or divine intervention. Ruin removes all nonmagic wealth/property and ownership records in the least reality-altering way. Sage grants, once within 1 year, a truthful meditative answer plus insight for applying it. Shield creates a DM-chosen rare-or-rarer magic armor with which you are proficient; if proficient with no armor, your unarmored base AC instead becomes 12 + Dexterity modifier. Ship grants three DM-chosen skill proficiencies. Skull creates an avatar of death that duels you alone until one dies; helpers each summon their own avatar, and creatures slain by an avatar cannot be restored to life. Staff creates a DM-chosen rare-or-rarer rod, staff, or wand. Stairway lets you either reduce declared draws by two or receive a DM-chosen rare-or-rarer wondrous item. Star raises one ability by 2, maximum 24. Statue petrifies you into marble until greater restoration or similar magic. Sun grants 50,000 XP and a random DM-determined wondrous item. Talons disintegrates all magic items you wear or carry; artifacts vanish instead. Tavern raises Charisma by 2 to maximum 22. Temple binds a deity or similar power to grant one future DM-defined divine intervention before you die; if unused at death, it instead casts resurrection on you, then the obligation ends. Throne grants Persuasion proficiency and expertise plus rightful ownership of a monster-held small keep. Tomb grants one component-free true resurrection casting usable within 1 year, with your choice of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Tower draws two extra cards but lets you choose one to resolve and return the other. Tree changes unarmored base AC to 15 + Dexterity modifier but gives fire vulnerability until wish, divine intervention, or similar magic. Undead creates a revenant somewhere on the Material Plane that hunts you until 1 year passes, it kills you, or wish permanently banishes it. Void traps your soul in a guarded object at a DM-chosen place, incapacitates your body, ends further draws, and can only have its location revealed—not restored—by wish. Warrior raises Strength by 2 to maximum 22. Well grants three cantrips of your choice from any spell list.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:deck-of-many-th.effectSummary: A legendary deck normally containing 13 cards, or 22 cards in 25% of decks. Before drawing, declare how many cards you will draw; excess draws have no effect, each declared card must be drawn within 1 hour of the last, and failing to finish causes the remaining declared cards to fly out and resolve simultaneously. Cards resolve immediately and normally fade then return to the deck; Fool and Jester do not. Card mapping: Ace♦ Vizier, K♦ Sun, Q♦ Moon, J♦ Star, 2♦ Comet; Ace♥ Fates, K♥ Throne, Q♥ Key, J♥ Knight, 2♥ Gem; Ace♣ Talons, K♣ Void, Q♣ Flames, J♣ Skull, 2♣ Idiot; Ace♠ Donjon, K♠ Ruin, Q♠ Euryale, J♠ Rogue, 2♠ Balance; Joker trademark Fool, other Joker Jester. The 22-card-only cards are Vizier, Comet, Fates, Gem, Idiot, Donjon, Balance, and Fool. Draw effects: Balance reverses law/chaos and good/evil alignment axes, true neutral/unaligned unaffected. Comet grants enough XP for one level if you single-handedly defeat the next hostile monster or group. Donjon imprisons you in suspended animation in an extradimensional sphere, leaves all gear behind, defeats divination, and ends further draws; wish reveals the prison but does not free you. Euryale curses you with -2 to all saves until ended by a god or Fates. Fates lets you erase one event at any time before death as if it never happened. Flames makes a powerful devil your enemy until one of you dies. Fool loses 10,000 XP without reducing you below your current level threshold, discards itself, and forces another draw counting as the same declared draw. Gem creates 25 jewelry pieces worth 2,000 gp each or 50 gems worth 1,000 gp each. Idiot permanently reduces Intelligence by 1d4+1 to minimum 1 and grants one extra draw. Jester grants 10,000 XP or two extra draws. Key creates a DM-chosen rare-or-rarer magic weapon you are proficient with. Knight creates a loyal same-race 4th-level fighter under your control until death. Moon grants 1d3 wish castings. Rogue makes a DM-chosen NPC hostile until wish or divine intervention ends that hostility. Ruin removes all nonmagic wealth, property, and proof of ownership. Skull summons an avatar of death for a solo duel; helpers summon their own avatars, and creatures slain by an avatar cannot be restored to life. Star raises one ability by 2 to maximum 24. Sun grants 50,000 XP and a random DM-determined wondrous item. Talons destroys every magic item you wear or carry; artifacts vanish rather than being destroyed. Throne grants Persuasion proficiency and expertise plus rightful ownership of a monster-held small keep. Vizier, once within 1 year, gives a truthful meditative answer plus insight for applying it. Void traps your soul in a guarded object at a DM-chosen place, incapacitates your body, ends further draws, and wish can only reveal the soul-prison's location. If cards are used individually with the optional Book of Many Things standalone properties, each has its own reusable-after-dawn power unless noted: Balance action against a visible target within 30 feet, DC 17 Constitution or 4d8 necrotic and you heal the necrotic damage dealt. Comet action creates a 20-foot-radius meteor at a visible point within 120 feet, DC 17 Dexterity, 6d6 bludgeoning + 6d6 fire or half. Donjon action targets a visible creature within 30 feet, DC 17 Charisma or banished to an extraplanar prison for 1 minute before returning to its space or nearest open space. Euryale action targets a visible creature within 30 feet, DC 17 Constitution; failure restrains, then another save at end of its next turn ends it on success or petrifies it until greater restoration or similar magic on failure. Fates bonus action grants a willing visible creature within 30 feet advantage on attacks, checks, and saves until your next turn while attacks against it have disadvantage. Flames action summons the card's specific CR 8-or-lower devil within 30 feet for 1 minute or until 0 HP; while you hold the card it obeys your no-action verbal commands, otherwise DM controls it. Fool action targets a visible creature within 30 feet, DC 17 Wisdom or for 1 minute it cannot cast spells or activate magic items, has disadvantage on saves, and other creatures resist all damage it deals. Gem stores one DM-chosen 6th-level spell, cast as an action at +9 spell attack/save DC 17. Jester action casts Otto's irresistible dance at DC 17 and grants advantage on concentration saves for it. Key has 5 uses, all restored at dawn, to cast silent knock as an action. Knight action throws the card within 60 feet to become a deck defender for up to 1 minute, obeying commands, otherwise Dodging and avoiding danger, reverting at 0 HP or on command; this power is once per dawn. Moon action transforms you for 1 minute into a wolflike biped with resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing plus +1d6 force on weapon and unarmed hits. Puzzle action disables all non-covered traps within 60 feet, while spell-created traps are suppressed 10 minutes. Rogue adds +6d6 force to one weapon hit while holding the card. Ruin action casts disintegrate at DC 17. Sage action casts contact other plane with the depicted figure answering. Skull action casts spirit of death at 6th level with +9 spell attack/save DC 17. Star bonus action grants advantage on all saves for 10 minutes. Sun action casts sunbeam at DC 17 from the card. Talons action targets one visible non-artifact magic item within 120 feet and suppresses its magic for 1 minute. Throne action grants advantage on Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) for 1 minute and allows command at DC 17 as an action during that minute. Void action targets up to three visible creatures within 120 feet; any target native to a different plane makes DC 17 Charisma or is banished back to that plane.
